title: April 29th – May 7th Trainings
body:
2019 Training

The University of Florida, along with its in country partner the Toledo Institute for Development and Environment, held its first set of trainings under the ‘Strengthening Civil Society Organization and Civil Servant Capacity in Belize through Partnerships” project. The project that is being funded by the US Embassy Belize, facilitated the training of Belizean CSOs/NGOs and Civil Servants. Our training by location saw the following participants:

Civil Servants:

Belize City, April 29-30, 2019
